authority: engineering refinement of R14 strict P256/SPKI/DER and canonical encoding; O41 per-file gate
scope: CryptoEncoding primitives, not signature verification/identity/admission or key custody

canonicalBase64Url.rule: URL alphabet only, no padding/whitespace; exact decode/reencode equality; size rejected before decode allocation
canonicalBase64Url.empty: primitive permits empty; caller required-field schemas reject empties where forbidden

p256Spki.rule: exact91-byte DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo with id-ecPublicKey + prime256v1 and65-byte uncompressed point; no BER/explicit curves/compressed alternate wire representation
p256Spki.point: unsigned32-byte X/Y each<p, y^2=x^3-3x+b modp; finite and on P256 cofactor1 curve; JCA public factory result must retain canonical encoded bytes/point/curve/order/cofactor
p256Spki.fingerprint: SHA256 exact validated canonical SPKI bytes; never caller app/signature/serial as administrator identity
p256Spki.withdrawWhen: an approved provider/interop requirement needs alternate public-key transport; specify canonical normalization and identity tests before expanding parser, never silently accept ASN1 aliases

ecdsaDer.rule: 8..72bytes, short definite DER sequence length, exactly two minimal positive integer scalars in1..n-1, no suffix
ecdsaDer.equivalence: accept both valid s and n-s; format validity is not successful signature verification; no low-S identity split

digest: SHA256 bounded<=65536-byte snapshot, hex lowercase64 characters; large mail objects require separate streaming digest, not whole-object buffering in this primitive
